jobs.title: Hardware Technical Program Manager, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Hardware Technical Program Manager, Energy Storage:

We are seeking a Hardware Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the development, testing, and manufacturing of complex, box-level electronics assemblies. You will own program execution from concept through production, coordinating across hardware engineering, validation, supply chain, and operations. This role is about making sure our hardware — from circuit boards and flex assemblies to enclosures, connectors, and integrated box builds — is designed for reliability, tested thoroughly, and built to scale.

Responsibilities Will Include:

- Drive end-to-end hardware program execution (requirements → design → validation → NPI → ramp)

- Lead cross-functional teams spanning mechanical, electrical, firmware, industrial design, test, and manufacturing engineering

- Plan and manage prototype and production builds, including materials, logistics, and factory readiness

- Oversee board and flex releases, system integration, and validation testing (DVT/PVT/MP builds)

- Partner with suppliers and contract manufacturers to drive DFM/DFT reviews, yield improvement, and issue resolution

- Maintain clear build plans, risk registers, and program dashboards; proactively manage schedule and resource risks

- Serve as the primary interface between Redwood engineering teams and external manufacturing partners

- Provide transparent updates to stakeholders and leadership, highlighting status, risks, and key decisions

Desired Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or related Engineering discipline (advanced degree a plus)

- 5+ years of experience in hardware program management, hardware engineering, or manufacturing operations

- Proven success driving NPI builds and scaling hardware programs to volume production

- Strong understanding of box-level assemblies (PCBs, flex circuits, harnessing, enclosures, thermal systems)

- Exceptional organizational, communication, and leadership skills; proven ability to thrive in high-ambiguity environments

- Willingness to travel to Redwood’s sites, suppliers, and contract manufacturers as needed

The position is full-time and located in San Francisco, CA . Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills.

California Pay Range:
$153,000 — $248,500 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Production Engineering
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Senior Technical Program Manager, Production Engineering

Redwood Materials is searching for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join our Production Engineering team in Sparks, Nevada. This team owns the engineering work that keeps our production lines running and takes them to full rate. In this role you will run the programs that move production from where it is today to where it needs to be on throughput, yield, uptime, and cost, working with process, mechanical, electrical, controls, and manufacturing engineers to scope the work, sequence it around production windows, and get it installed, qualified, and handed to operations. You will report status, flag schedule risk early, and build the recovery plan when a program slips. You will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, spend real time on the plant floor, and contribute to the tools and processes that make the wider team faster.

Hours
Full-time

Responsibilities will include:

- Own the program plan for production engineering projects, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, and acceptance criteria, keeping it current on milestones, deliverables, and percent complete, and managing scope changes through approval

- Drive throughput, yield, uptime, and cost-per-unit improvement programs from problem definition through qualification and handoff to operations

- Sequence engineering work around production and planned outage windows with operations and maintenance

- Run the commissioning and qualification path for new and modified equipment, including factory and site acceptance testing, safety review, and operational readiness

- Coordinate across process, mechanical, electrical, controls, quality, environment, health and safety, supply chain, and operations to close dependencies and unblock the team

- Track and report program status, key metrics, and dashboards for site and executive review, surfacing risks early and escalating delays with options rather than problems

- Run post-project reviews, roll learnings into the next program, and mentor other program managers on planning, reporting, and risk management

Desired Qualifications:

- BS or MS in Engineering, or other evidence of exceptional ability

- 2-6 years of program or project management experience in a manufacturing, process, or heavy industrial environment

- Track record delivering production ramp, capacity expansion, or continuous improvement programs inside an operating plant

- Able to read piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), process flow diagrams, and equipment specifications, and hold a technical conversation with the engineers doing the work

- Experience running commissioning, qualification, or operational readiness for production equipment

- Familiarity with lean and continuous improvement methods including root cause analysis, DMAIC, and Kaizen; PMP or Green Belt preferred but not required

- Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Office, and Microsoft Project

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to internal and external executives, and the ability to hold multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly fluid environment

- A Passion for sustainability and making the world a better place!

Physical Requirements:

- Wear proper personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary

- Walk the production floor for extended periods, climb stairs and ladders, and work near operating equipment

Working Conditions:

- Work across office, production floor, machine shop, chemical plant, and outdoor areas

- Exposure to noise, dust, heat, and cold

- Travel as needed, less than 10%

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

Software Technical Program Manager , Energy Storage:

Redwood Materials is currently searching for a Technical Program Manager to join as an early member of a new engineering team working on our Battery Energy Storage System product line .

In this role, you will focus on the development of software, embedded firmware, and systems controls and will drive cross-functional coordination across engineering, product, and operations teams to deliver intelligent, grid-interactive storage systems that are scalable, reliable, and safe.

This is a highly technical role where success requires understanding the unique challenges of developing production quality software and firmware in complex energy environments. Y ou will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy while contributing to the development of tools and processes that improve the organization’s productivity.

Responsibilities Will Include:

- Lead cross-functional development programs focused on embedded firmware for power electronics , energy management system software, and battery management software

- Drive the software development process, including planning and  facilitating sprints, backlog prioritization, standups, and sprint reviews to maintain team velocity and alignment

- Work closely with software, controls, systems, and electrical engineers to define program requirements, technical interfaces,  dependencies and validation strategies

- Track and communicate progress toward key milestones

- Ensure change management and version control processes are in place and aligned with the pace of system iteration

- BS/MS in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field

- 5+ years of technical program management experience focused on software and firmware in hardware-integrated systems . Experience power electronics or other energy products a strong plus

- Familiarity with software development lifecycle processes including Agile, CI/CD, code reviews, and release planning

- Proven  track record of managing software development for multidisciplinary products involving electrical, mechanical, and systems teams

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of building relationships with all levels of the organization and presenting to internal and external executives

- Proficiency in project tracking and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, MS Project, Asana)

- Self-motivated, with the ability to manage your work in a startup environment, balancing multiple priorities and deadlines

- A passion for sustainability and making the world a better place
